issues: Console warnings on /analysis/ENRG.JK load: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — emitted twice on mount. A Recharts ResponsiveContainer is being rendered inside a parent with 0/undefined dimensions (likely a tab-hidden or display:none panel like the candlestick chart before the Candlestick tab is clicked). Not user-visible, but noisy in console. Fix: set minWidth/minHeight on the container, or only mount the chart when its tab/section is active.
